description: Make AI phone calls, configure inbound agents, and manage phone numbers, voices and connected tools. Review call outcomes, transcripts and available recordings.
name: Patch MCP

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Start here to discover Patch actions, granted permissions, feature prerequisites and the next tools to call.

tools.name: place_call
tools.description: Place one real phone call FROM the selected outbound number (the authenticated user’s verified personal number by default) to accomplish a specific objective (book a table, ask a question, chase an order). A real-time voice agent handles the call, including automated phone menus and hold queues. Its default opening says who it is calling for and states the call's purpose. Use get_agent and update_agent for number settings and inbound greeting/instructions. Outbound greeting and system instructions are read-only through MCP; use objective and context for call-specific facts. Changes apply directly to new calls. Call facts are added automatically. The recording disclosure belongs in the first spoken turn that advances the objective, whether asking a question, making a request, or giving task-related details. Brief introductory chatter or an acknowledgment of a request to hold may come first. Naturally include “on a recorded line” in the introduction or response, using a natural equivalent in the selected call language. Returns immediately with a call_id and resolved locale, language, and voice; the call proceeds in the background and typically takes 2–5 minutes — poll get_call (pass wait_seconds to long-poll) until the status is terminal. The response includes a listen_url: a private web link where the user can hear the call live, watch the transcript, and stop the call — offer it to the user. Calls in Central America, Europe, North America, and South America, subject to route availability; never for emergencies. Calls involving a non-US/Canadian number require a paid plan from the first call. Rates vary by caller ID and destination; the response includes an estimated provider cost for one minute, including per-call costs. This estimate is not a final charge. Paid usage follows telephone, AI and any lookup costs, including unsuccessful attempts, and can update after the call. Calls can be placed at any time of day, any day of the week, and the user is responsible for fair use; one call runs at a time per account and volume is governed by the plan — rejections return a machine-readable `error` code with retry guidance, so relay the message to the user rather than retrying blindly. The voice agent receives the name of the person the call is for: if the account has no name on file the call is rejected with `user_name_required` — ask your user what name to give (e.g. "Sam" or "Sam at Acme"), then call again with it in `user_name`; it is saved to the account for future calls.

request_id.description: Optional retry key. Reuse the same UUID and arguments after a lost response to avoid a second call.

number_id.description: Account phone assignment ID from list_phone_numbers; omit to use the account default.

locale.description: Language the voice agent should use for the entire call. Choose one of the advertised BCP 47 tags for the active speech provider. The objective and context may be written in another language. Defaults to the selected source’s published preference in the phone workspace, otherwise the supported account preference, then English. Uses an available saved voice or the provider default. Applies only to this call; the selected language stays fixed for the entire call. Unsupported locales return unsupported_language before dialing

callee_name.description: Who is being called, e.g. "Zuni Café". Improves the conversation and the logs.

context.description: Extra facts the agent may reveal if asked (e.g. party preferences, callback number policy).

objective.description: What the call should achieve, with all needed specifics and acceptable fallbacks. E.g. "Book a table for 2 tonight at 19:30 under 'Iddo'. Acceptable window 19:00–20:30."

to.description: Destination phone number in E.164, e.g. +14155551234. Supported: Central America, Europe, North America, and South America (Telnyx regions; Caribbean excluded). Destination country codes: BZ, CR, SV, GT, HN, NI, PA, AX, AL, AD, AT, BE, BA, BG, HR, CY, CZ, DK, EE, FO, FI, FR, DE, GI, GR, GL, GG, HU, IS, IE, IM, IT, JE, LV, LI, LT, LU, MK, MT, MC, ME, NL, NO, PL, PT, XK, RO, RU, SM, RS, SK, SI, ES, SJ, SE, CH, UA, GB, VA, US, CA, MX, PM, AR, BO, BR, CL, CO, EC, FK, GF, GY, PY, PE, SR, UY, VE.

timezone.description: Optional callee local IANA timezone, for example America/Chicago or Europe/London. Supply it when known from reliable context. If omitted, Patch uses phone-prefix timezone metadata when it identifies one zone, otherwise America/Chicago. Phone metadata can be inaccurate for moved or ported numbers.

user_name.description: The user name supplied to the voice agent for the call, e.g. "Sam" or "Sam at Acme". The default introduction uses the saved name when explaining who the call is for; a custom introduction follows the published outbound agent instructions. Only needed when place_call returned user_name_required: ask your user for it, do not invent one. Saved to the account for future calls; a later value updates the saved name.

call_id.description: Call identifier used with get_call, end_call and set_call_visibility.

locale.description: Resolved BCP 47 language/locale for this call.

anyOf.description: Free-call duration cap; null for paid calls.

listen_url.description: URL for the user to listen, read the transcript and stop an active call.

anyOf.description: Usage units reserved for the call.

estimated_total_cents_at_one_minute.description: Estimated provider cost for a one-minute call, including per-call costs; not a final charge.

anyOf.description: Estimated carrier cost for one minute; null when included in a combined service estimate.

outputSchema.description: Successful result or a machine-readable tool error.

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Get the status and, once terminal, the structured resolution of a call started with place_call. Returns instantly by default. Pass wait_seconds (max 50) to have the server hold the request and return early on any status change — fewer round trips while a call is in progress. Terminal statuses: completed, answered_silently, no_answer, busy, voicemail, failed, rejected, canceled, declined_recording, opted_out. rejected means safety screening declined the objective before dialing; error.message and resolution.summary explain why. Terminal calls include a `resolution` {outcome: achieved|partially_achieved|not_achieved|no_conversation|unknown, summary, commitments[], follow_ups[], key_facts[]} — read it before the transcript; it is the answer. unknown means the outcome could not be determined; review the transcript. Completed calls also carry the transcript (may be marked transcript_truncated) and a recording_url the user can listen to (private links expire after ~1 hour; on staging, fetch with the same OAuth Authorization: Bearer header). The resolution can lag the terminal status by a few seconds while it is extracted. Calls include the resolved locale, language, voice, and is_public; public calls return token-free listen and recording URLs that remain accessible while public. Use set_call_visibility only when the user explicitly asks to publish or make private. Every call includes a listen_url — the call page for the user (live audio + transcript while in progress; recording + transcript once ended). ended_by='user' on a canceled call means the user deliberately stopped it from that page — don't retry. recording_status=processing means the LiveKit session recording is being finalized and copied to private storage separately from the result. A recording can fail or be unavailable. Call get_call again, or pass wait_seconds on an already-terminal call to wait for a recording state change.

wait_seconds.description: 0 (default) = instant status check. Up to 50 = server-side long-poll.

call_id.description: Call identifier used with get_call, end_call and set_call_visibility.

locale.description: Resolved BCP 47 language/locale for this call.

is_public.description: Whether the call has a public link.

listen_url.description: URL for the user to listen, read the transcript and stop an active call.

outcome.description: Whether the call objective was met; unknown when review is unavailable or evidence is insufficient.

follow_ups.description: Actions the user still needs to take.

callee_requested_no_further_calls.description: Whether the recipient asked not to be called again.

at_ms.description: Milliseconds from the transcript timeline origin.

transcript.description: Conversation entries; empty before speech is available.

transcript_truncated.description: Whether earlier transcript content was omitted.

anyOf.description: Audio URL when ready; private URLs expire.
Reserved usage units; absent on legacy calls.

ended_by.description: Party or system that ended the call.

anyOf.description: ISO 8601 end time; null while active.

outputSchema.description: Successful result or a machine-readable tool error.

tools.name: set_call_visibility
tools.description: Make a call owned by the authenticated user public or private. Calls are private by default. Only publish when the user explicitly asks: a public call exposes its objective, phone numbers, transcript, result and audio to anyone with its permanent, token-free listen_url, including live audio while in progress. Set is_public to false to disable token-free access again; existing private signed links remain valid until they expire. Public visitors cannot stop the call or change visibility.

call_id.description: The id of a call owned by this account.

is_public.description: true publishes the call; false makes it private again.

call_id.description: Call identifier used with get_call, end_call and set_call_visibility.

is_public.description: Updated visibility; public links expose call data.

listen_url.description: URL for the user to listen, read the transcript and stop an active call.

outputSchema.description: Successful result or a machine-readable tool error.

tools.name: end_call
tools.description: End an in-progress call early. Patch requests disconnection by deleting the LiveKit room; a spoken farewell is not guaranteed. Check get_call for the resulting status. Use when the user changes their mind or the call is no longer needed. Available transcript snapshots are retained and the resolution is extracted separately.

call_id.description: Call identifier used with get_call, end_call and set_call_visibility.

ended.description: Whether an end request was applied; false if already terminal.

outputSchema.description: Successful result or a machine-readable tool error.

tools.name: list_phone_numbers
tools.description: List this account's phone numbers, active direction availability and default_number_id. Use number_id to select a source for place_call. Accepts calls:read or numbers:read; management settings and workspace_revision are included only with numbers:read. Does not expose agent instructions or voices.

settings.description: Number-management settings, included only with numbers:read permission.

workspace_revision.description: Included only with numbers:read; use when changing the default number.

tools.name: get_phone_number
tools.description: Read one owned number by number_id; omit it to inspect the default outbound number. Accepts calls:read or numbers:read. Number-management settings, revision, recovery deadline and workspace_revision require numbers:read. Does not place a call or expose agent instructions or voices.

settings.description: Number-management settings, included only with numbers:read permission.

workspace_revision.description: Included only with numbers:read; use when changing the default number.

tools.name: list_activity
tools.description: Read owned history newest first. kind=call (default) requires calls:read and returns call statuses, resolution summaries/outcomes and listen links. kind=test requires configuration:read and returns finished synthetic tests. kind=all requires both permissions. Pass next_cursor unchanged with the same kind to fetch older entries.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read your profile, caller verification, revision, account defaults, setup progress and notices. Use update_account for profile changes and set_onboarding for setup state.

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Update supplied profile, account-wide mode (standard or beta), language and voice defaults using the revision from get_account. Language and voice defaults require configuration permission. Internal system prompts are not exposed through MCP.

tools.name: set_onboarding
tools.description: Save only setup progress: choose inbound/outbound intent and mark the checklist checkout, complete or skipped. Checkout records progress only; this tool never opens payment, buys a plan or acquires a number.

tools.name: list_authorized_apps
tools.description: List applications authorized to access this account. These are distinct from external tools used by voice agents.

tools.name: revoke_authorized_app
tools.description: Disconnect an authorized application. Revoking the current application ends this MCP connection.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: Find the identifiers and revisions of your inbound and outbound agents.

tools.name: search_phone_numbers
tools.description: Find included US or Canadian numbers. Plus automatically prefers any unclaimed Patch number in the requested country, then falls back to area-code search. Pro plans use area-code search so the user can choose a number. Plus can use reuse_only without an area code to check its existing inventory. Offers expire; claim the chosen offer.

tools.name: claim_phone_number
tools.description: Acquire an offered number using your plan allowance. Reuse request_id after an interrupted response.

tools.name: get_number_claim
tools.description: Read provisioning progress for a number claim.

tools.name: update_phone_number
tools.description: Change a label, inbound/outbound availability or retention preference using the number revision. Enabling an unpublished direction activates its initial defaults; saved drafts and existing live settings are preserved.

tools.name: set_default_phone_number
tools.description: Choose the default outbound number using workspace_revision from get_phone_number.

tools.name: get_forwarding_carrier
tools.description: Suggest forwarding instructions for the verified personal number during inbound onboarding. Carrier lookups are cached for a day.

tools.name: get_forwarding_instructions
tools.description: Get carrier-specific steps for forwarding an existing phone to an owned Patch number. The user or carrier must activate forwarding; Patch cannot activate it remotely.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Read active user-configurable settings and revision. Inbound includes editable greeting/instructions; outbound prompt text and Patch internal system prompts are not exposed. Settings are null until configured.

tools.name: update_agent
tools.description: Apply supplied settings directly to an agent for future calls using the revision from get_agent. Inbound greeting and instructions are editable. Outbound greeting and system instructions are not exposed or editable through MCP; supply per-call facts in place_call objective and context. Use set_agent_connectors separately for external connections.

tools.name: reset_agent
tools.description: Reset user-configurable agent settings to defaults for future calls. Removes active external connection assignments and requires connector permission when assignments exist.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List voices for the current account mode. Change mode with update_account. Beta offers Phonic stock voices only; assign their ID using phonicVoice in update_agent. Standard uses voice and supports entitled custom voices.

provider_voice_id.description: Provider voice ID used when assigning a built-in voice to an agent.

voice_id.description: Patch clone ID for renaming, deleting or checking verification.

provider_voice_id.description: Provider ID for preview and agent assignment once the clone is ready and the account is entitled.

tools.name: get_voice_preview
tools.description: Get a short-lived playable URL using provider_voice_id from list_voices, or Claudia's provider ID. Use the provider identity here; clone management uses voice_id. Built-in catalog voices already include sample URLs.

tools.name: create_voice_upload
tools.description: Create an expiring audio upload URL. PUT the file bytes there, then call create_voice with the upload_id and the user’s own-voice consent.

tools.name: create_voice
tools.description: Clone an uploaded sample of the user’s own voice. consent must represent the user’s explicit permission; never infer consent.

tools.name: rename_voice
tools.description: Rename one of your voice clones.

tools.name: delete_voice
tools.description: Delete your voice clone and its provider samples. A voice in an active call cannot be deleted.

tools.name: verify_voice
tools.description: Refresh provider verification status. If verification is still required, the user must complete the provider’s verification with support.

tools.name: list_connectors
tools.description: Read this account's saved voice-agent connections, authorization state and common providers. Returns setup_url for entering API keys or custom OAuth credentials on the website. Reads stored metadata only; does not contact providers, discover tools, assign agents or invoke external actions.

tools.name: get_connector_tools
tools.description: Read the cached individual tool definitions for an owned connection. These functions are exposed separately to the voice agent on calls after set_agent_connectors assigns the connection. This read does not invoke them, refresh discovery or return credentials.

tools.name: create_connector
tools.description: Save a hosted voice-agent MCP connection requiring no credentials or standard browser OAuth, without contacting it or assigning agents. Never ask for or submit API keys, tokens, client secrets or credential-bearing URLs in chat. For API-key or custom OAuth setup, send the user to setup_url from list_connectors, then use the saved connector_id. Next use connect_connector for browser authorization and discovery, then set_agent_connectors to grant access.

tools.name: connect_connector
tools.description: Contact an owned connection to discover or refresh its individual voice-agent tools. May begin third-party OAuth and return authorization_url for the user to approve; never collect verification codes or credentials in chat. Does not invoke external tools or change agent assignments. Inspect get_connector_tools after authorization.

tools.name: add_common_connector
tools.description: Create or return a managed Exa web-search connection using this account's existing paid entitlement. New connections are unassigned. Does not subscribe, charge, search, discover tools or change assignments. Next use connect_connector, inspect get_connector_tools and explicitly set_agent_connectors.

tools.name: set_agent_connectors
tools.description: Replace the external connections available to one active voice agent for future calls. Review get_connector_tools and obtain authorization for those capabilities first. Every discovered function is exposed individually to the voice agent; it may invoke those external actions within its call instructions. An empty connector_ids list removes access. Does not invoke tools or change unrelated agent settings.

tools.name: remove_connector
tools.description: Delete an owned connection and its saved credentials. Also revoke that connection from every assigned agent without applying unrelated settings. Requires configuration permission when an agent assignment is removed. Does not invoke external tools or revoke consent at the third-party provider.

tools.name: list_test_scenarios
tools.description: List synthetic test scenarios and available responder outcomes. Tests use fictional data and never invoke connected external tools.

tools.name: start_agent_test
tools.description: Run one isolated synthetic conversation against the active agent settings at the supplied revision. Outbound supports preset or custom fictional scenarios; inbound requires custom_scenario. Uses LiveKit test rooms and may consume AI usage. Never dials a phone number, publishes settings or invokes connected external tools.

responder_outcome.description: An outcome ID from list_test_scenarios, or custom fictional facts for the responder. Omit to use the first outcome.

tools.name: get_agent_test
tools.description: Read a synthetic test’s status, transcript, result and transcript expiry.

tools.name: get_agent_test_listener
tools.description: Get a short-lived, subscribe-only LiveKit credential for listening to your running synthetic test from a compatible client.

tools.name: stop_agent_test
tools.description: Stop your synthetic test and retain its captured result.

tools.name: get_call_diagnostics
tools.description: Read private diagnostic events for an owned call. Public call visibility never grants access to diagnostics.

tools.name: get_call_listener
tools.description: Get a short-lived, subscribe-only LiveKit credential for listening to your active call from a compatible client.

tools.name: resume_operation
tools.description: Recover an interrupted number claim, voice clone or subscription attempt owned by this account and the original authorization grant. Requires that operation's original permissions. May reconcile number provisioning, find the exact existing provider voice, or retry the persisted subscription request with its original idempotency key. Never creates a replacement request or authorizes new spending. Completed results and definitive failures are returned without repeating provider actions.

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: Recover a request’s durable outcome. A running/needs_attention operation must not be retried under a new ID.

tools.name: get_billing
tools.description: Read plans, usage, subscription state, payment-method summary and invoices. Reconciles subscription state with Stripe; use invoice_cursor for older invoices.

tools.name: preview_subscription_change
tools.description: Create a 15-minute quote for starting a subscription, changing its plan, canceling renewal at period end, or undoing cancellation/a scheduled downgrade. Returns immediate charges, monthly list price, effective time and allowances. May read Stripe and save a local quote; does not charge or change a subscription. Show the complete quote to the user and obtain explicit approval before execute_subscription_change. Each preview creates a new quote.

amount_due.description: Amount due now in the currency's minor units.

recurring_amount.description: Monthly list price in minor units, before discounts and tax.

tools.name: execute_subscription_change
tools.description: Apply the exact, unexpired quote the user explicitly approved after seeing its immediate charges, recurring price, effective time and limits. May charge a saved payment method, change the subscription, cancel renewal or undo a scheduled change. Set user_authorized=true only after that approval; never infer permission to spend. Reuse the same request_id and arguments after a lost response. Return any payment/authentication URL for the user to complete; never collect payment credentials in chat.

user_authorized.description: The user explicitly approved this quote's charges and terms. Never infer approval from a request to preview.

tools.name: update_billing_profile
tools.description: Update the Stripe customer’s billing name, email or address. Payment credentials are never accepted here.

tools.name: create_billing_portal
tools.description: Create a Stripe-hosted billing portal link for this account's existing Stripe customer. Creating the link does not charge, change or cancel a subscription; the user chooses and confirms any billing changes on Stripe. Returns to Patch's fixed billing page. Reuse request_id after a lost response. Never request or accept card details in chat.

tools.name: sales_get_workspace
tools.description: View your team role, campaign, rep availability, browser or phone audio status, assigned prospect opening transcript, connection timings, and permitted reporting.

tools.name: sales_create_team
tools.description: Create a company workspace and choose 1–50 rep seats. Managers do not consume a rep seat. This does not subscribe or place calls.

tools.name: sales_invite_rep
tools.description: Create a one-time invitation link bound to the rep phone number. The manager must share it; Patch does not send a message.

tools.name: sales_revoke_invitation
tools.description: Manager revokes an unused team invitation and frees its reserved seat.

tools.name: sales_get_invitation
tools.description: Review the team and phone associated with a one-time invitation before accepting it.

tools.name: sales_join_team
tools.description: Accept a one-time invitation for the authenticated verified phone.

tools.name: sales_remove_rep
tools.description: Remove a rep from the manager’s team.

tools.name: sales_import_list
tools.description: Manager imports a CSV for the team. Set calling_authorized only when the user confirms authorization. Does not place calls.

tools.name: sales_list_contacts
tools.description: Manager views a page of team prospects and calling statuses.

tools.name: sales_export_list
tools.description: Manager exports a team prospect list and outcomes.

tools.name: sales_start_campaign
tools.description: Manager starts a shared call block with 1–5 total lines. Only call lists the user has authorized. Live answers go to ready reps; this may place prospect calls.

tools.name: sales_campaign_action
tools.description: Manager pauses, resumes, or ends the shared call block.

tools.name: sales_rep_action
tools.description: Rep joins, marks ready, pauses, hangs up a prospect, or leaves. Join defaults to browser audio and returns the workspace URL so the rep can grant microphone access. Choose audio_mode=phone explicitly for fallback; Patch calls their verified phone and they press 1. Both modes require explicit Ready before receiving prospects.

tools.name: sales_heartbeat
tools.description: Keep the rep session attended and eligible for calls. Send every 15 seconds while the rep is present; manager presence is not required for other reps to continue.

tools.name: sales_set_disposition
tools.description: Rep records the assigned prospect’s outcome, notes, and optional callback time.

tools.name: sales_create_checkout
tools.description: Manager creates hosted Stripe checkout at $99 per rep seat per month. Each seat adds 5,000 attempts and 2,000 phone minutes to the shared allowance. The customer completes payment on Stripe; reps do not need their own subscription.

tools.name: sales_change_seats
tools.description: Manager changes the number of paid rep seats. Hosted Stripe confirmation may be required.

tools.name: sales_billing_portal
tools.description: Manager opens the Stripe billing portal for the team subscription.
